title: Form metadata type follow-ups after #37086: two unmeasured arms, transaction ownership in batch routes, revertCommit docblock, rollback pins, container listing
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8wf3DSPRevwNnYLcM
Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet · finding class b · reach: the `form` metadata type landed by #37366 (card #37086) at main `adb65d1615`

## What

Residuals the contract reviews of #37366 / #37422 recorded and the seat took out of the landing, each small, none blocking. Every item is a measurement or a pin first; a code change only where the measurement says so.

- [ ] **Destructive still-shown-by, `form` arm** — the destructive-change "still shown by" reading does not yet read `form` items; measure whether a removal that a form still references is reported, and add the arm (with a CONTROL) if not.
- [ ] **Unmanaged copy, form-name prefix** — when a form is copied out of a package, confirm the name takes the same `OBJECT.KEY`-style prefix rule as the other copied types; pin it either way.
- [ ] **Transaction ownership in batch routes** (review N10) — `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts` (~line 566): state, or pin, which side owns a transaction that was opened outside the route when the batch carries form writes.
- [ ] **`revertCommit` docblock** (review N12) — the docblock's description of the walk order does not match the code; correct the text.
- [ ] **Rollback pins for page and permission set** — the rollback path fixed alongside the form work also covers `page` and `permission_set` items; add the regression pins for those two types.
- [ ] **Container listing and withdrawn members** — the container listing still decides membership from the member's own listing flag rather than the member's current published state; measure and align the listing with the read side's rule.

## Acceptance (proposed, for triage)

Each box closes with a test (or a measured reason no change is needed) named in the PR. No public text names more than the rule.
